The '''Imperial Cabinet''' was an organization on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gandle Ott]] that supported Acting-Governor [[Marja Lang]] following the departure of the world's [[Unidentified Imperial Governor (Gandle Ott)|previous]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]].
